scenes.caption: Zara and her cousins.
scenes.say: This is Zara with her cousins. They line up for the family photo.

scenes.caption: Rows of seven.
scenes.say: Seven cousins stand in one row. That is one group of seven.

scenes.caption: Three rows.
scenes.say: Three rows of seven make twenty-one. Three sevens are twenty-one.

scenes.caption: Nine children.
scenes.say: Now nine children stand in a square, three rows of three.

scenes.caption: A square number.
scenes.say: Nine is a square number, because three times three is nine.

scenes.caption: Shukriya!
scenes.say: Rows of seven and squares of nine. Shukriya, Zara!
